note: GLSL user shaders the PushMPC IINA plugin bundles. IINA renders through OpenGL 4.1 (no compute shaders), so only fragment / textureGather shaders are listed; build.py refuses any file with //!COMPUTE. Each file is fetched from an immutable URL (a commit, a gist revision or a release asset) and checked against its git blob SHA-1 (gitBlobSha1, what GitHub's API reports for the file) or SHA-256. Licences: FSR (MIT, AMD FidelityFX port), RAVU (LGPL-3.0), FSRCNNX (GPL-3.0); all compatible with PushMPC's GPL-3.0. The licence text stays in each file's header and is listed in SHADER-LICENSES.txt inside the package.
